text: Fear. It's a tolerance that we are naturally born with, just like how plants are able to adapt to soil that make havoc of their own rootstocks.
To shatter our will, they'll need to spread a much great 'dosage' of fear in Brentwood.
Freda is the greatest testament.
\nShe is so fragile that you could break her simply by bumping into her, but she persisted among that crowd of terrifying men up till now.
But I can tell that she needs someone to confide in and vent her fear.
Will... he's not mature enough. It's not very likely he would understand how Freda feels.
Perhaps I can help her?
You didn't bring my order to my tent... Magdelene.
And you didn't leave Brentwood either. A pitiful decision.
He seems very feeble, even more so than yesterday.
\nWhat happened?
Why didn't you leave?
This is my home.
Do you have a new order for me? I can bring it to you along with the flowers last night.
...You don't have to worry about those orders anymore.
I'm here to say goodbye.
I'm leaving soon... to fight as part of the Nachzehrer King's army...
Alright...
Goodbye, if that's what you wanted to hear from me.
You're too naive... to the point of foolishness.
Everything that I've tried to protect, always courts its own destruction.
Perhaps I've been wrong from the start.
I don't understand what you're saying, Shovel.
I used to be incredibly jealous of all of you.
Victoria used to be the noblest and strongest nation there was. Naturally, you possessed many great things, and rightfully so.
With the metallurgy you originated and the Steam Knights, you conquered another empire. With your mystifying art and rich academia, you attracted all of Terra's geniuses...
Yet now, you've halted your outward conquest. Now, your rulers only indulge in parties and wine, only ever boasting about the medals on their chest.
They crush their own glory, and they are destined to be replaced—
Hm? You still have this wall clock...
Time really flies. The town's citizens must all have gone to the work site.
What do you mean?
Your deaths are unavoidable, Magdelene.
The Sanguinarch is an impatient man.
That's why the ritual was pushed forward, and under that Feline's leadership, the mission was indeed completed most marvelously.
Everyone here will be the key to the ritual's activation.
Of course, that includes you.
Ritual... Key...
He was stopped by the devils at the Sarkaz barracks just now.
Freda... Do you see that?
The blood-colored worm is staring at me.
<color=#cc0000>'The entire town will be the key to the ritual's activation.'</color>
The key...
\nMy soul is trembling.
I need to go find Freda!
Let me go!
You mustn't leave this greenhouse.
Wait a little longer, Magdelene. I'll be here with you.
Until we bid each other farewell for the last time.
Why... The people of the town have never done anything against your wishes!
Freda and everyone fulfilled each and every one of your requests!
His Highness decided to carry out this war, and your dukes responded. This outcome has nothing to do with us or you.
All we need to do is follow our orders.
Then let me warn the people at the work site! Just pretend you don't know anything like before, please!
I serve His Highness, and I won't allow you to quash this ritual...
Not unless you make it past me, Magdelene.
Can you do it, Gardener?
\nHe grabs me by the hand, but places it on a pair of scissors in his hand.
\nThere seems to be a ray of longing burning in the depths of his ashen eyes.
\nWhat is this prideful man longing for?
\nRelease? Pity? Or is it perhaps... that word that I can't bring myself to touch?
I notice that even though the two of us have spent a very long time together in this greenhouse, I've never actually truly understood this man.
\nBut I have to leave now. Just as he said, there is no time.
I'm sorry.
\nI can't stand by and watch anymore—
Magdelene, where are you going? Why the rush?
Is that... blood on your clothes...? Are you okay?
It's fine—I cut my finger while I was pruning branches...
Henk, where's Freda?
Freda? After she came back from the barracks by herself this morning, she went straight to the Sarkaz officers.
She seemed rather out of it, and she kept saying sorry no matter who she ran into.
Did something happen?
Everyone has to leave this place right now.
And the farther, the better!
What's with all of you being so bloody barmy today?
There's no time to explain. I need to tell everyone else!
But we're almost finished! Besides, if we all ditch work, what are we supposed to do when those officers find us?
Fireworks? Where?
Who blew that wall open? Is that... Freda?
The last time I saw such beautiful fireworks. It was the harvest festival when I was ten.
\nGrandfather put me on his shoulders and walked through the crowd.
\nEveryone looked up to the fireworks blooming in the sky astonished. Everyone kept quiet, only for the silence to be torn apart by the explosive sound wave a moment later.
\nThis is just like that.
Freda set off the cannon Mr. West was hiding for the harvest festival. There are countless Sarkaz pulling her from behind.
\nDrenched in blood, she is shouting something, but whatever she is trying to say, it's buried by the cannon's loud roar.
\nShe is buried by the wave of Sarkaz gushing toward her and torn apart.
A flame burning bright in the middle of the day—
\nThe cannons keep roaring.
\nA grand ceremony has come to Brentwood ahead of schedule.
What just happened? Is there an earthquake?
R-Run!
You're bleeding... Bollocks... Stay away! Those disgusting monsters are dripping from your body!
What are the Sarkaz trying to do?
Henk, Henk! You can't close your eyes...
I... I'm starting to feel very tired too... So sleepy...
I can feel my own blood fluttering out of my body.
\nBefore disappearing into the earth.
Magdelene! Hang in there!
Captain, I got her!
Everyone, hold onto the ropes as tight as you can. Do not touch the ground, no matter what!
Hurry and help them!
Magdelene, you can't fall asleep!
Rockrock?
This guy's so heavy!
Mmm...
Feist... The Self-Salvation Corps... Why are you...?
We figured something went wrong when we saw fireworks in the middle of the day! They sealed the wall we blew open yesterday, but that cannon gave us a new path.
Hold onto Rockrock's hand, Magdelene! Our forces don't have enough manpower, and we're bringing everyone to evacuate as soon as we can!
Woahh! Feist, your zipline's even faster after those modifications you made!
Right, where is Mayor Freda? We haven't been able to locate her.
...Freda is—
Drat, why did my zipline start shaking?
What about that weak garrison commander? Where is he hiding this time?
Well, no matter... I'll take over command.
I can feel it. My blood... is boiling.
No need to contact Major Ulšulah's squad. We can take care of these laughable Victorians by ourselves.
Kill them all.
The garrison here is mounting a counter-attack. They're putting more pressure on us than any Sarkaz we've faced before!
How much explosive does Old Weiss still have outside? Can he make it here in time to back us up?
Probably not happening. Not counting the members who laid the ziplines for us, we barely had any fighting men to begin with.
Start the Crawlers! We need to break through by force!
Rockrock, watch out! Your zipline!
Ah—
That hurts—
name: Rockrock

text: Magdelene, are you okay?
name: Rockrock

text: Can you walk? Gah, these disgusting things—
On the sundering earth, a large number of red worms keep gushing onto surface. They chew on every soul they can reach and suck their blood.
This is the Prince's blessing. It's the kindness the Royal Court left for us.
In our bodies... our purest blood is now awakening. Let's waste no more time on these Victorians!
Rockrock, you should go—
The Feline girl named Rockrock takes out a dagger from her waist and stuffs it into my hand.
\nA large group of Sarkaz are closing in on our location.
Magdelene, get ready to fight.
It's not that hard. None of us... had any combat experience before.
Take a deep breath and make up your mind.
Make up my mind.
\nRight.
\nJust like... that Sarkaz officer who collapsed among the fluttering petals.
I grip the dagger tight.
A shot rings out.
Artillery fire? I thought we used up all our explosives!
Quick, Rockrock, Magdelene, now!
We were contacted by a few old friends. They brought a whole backup unit! They even have an identification code—
Identification code?
\nIs it the military? Victorian... Right... the military is responding to the war.
\nThey must be a group of ice-cold men. They're here to kill the Sarkaz and save the Victorians. They—
'The Exemplars!'
A thick, roiling cloud of dust is kicked up into the air all over within view. Again and again, bright flashes of light suddenly erupts across the ground.
\nWhat is that... A tank?
\nI can hear a firm, persevering female voice coming from Feist's communicator.
This is Tank Fire Team Horn. All units, make sure to stay clear of my blast zone.
Grenade loaded. Firing second barrage!
Opening created. Cover the Self-Salvation Corps and all citizens!
Horn, continue laying suppressive fire.
Those Arts Circles... We need to find a way to stop this bloody witchcraft.
Vina, have someone else drive. I want to join the ground combat!
Hannah, eyes on the road!
Alright, alright!
Get the tank as close to the core of the Arts Circle as possible. I'll take care of that thing!
Vina!
You have other tasks.
All units, follow regular deployment formation. Morgan, Hannah, follow Horn's orders and cut open a path for the tank.
Lieutenant Shearer, Dagda, Delphine, take command of the ground forces and form a defensive line. Stop the Sanguinarch's worms.
I'm on it.
Acknowledged.
Acknowledged.
Mr. Misery, I'll leave the commander of the enemy forces to you.
All you need to do is boldly execute your plan.
Feist, it's been a while. We shall exchange pleasantries later. I need the Self-Salvation Corps to help set up a zipline that will take me above the Arts Circle.
On it!
We have no time to lose. Let us take care of the strange Arts Circle first.
I will leave my rear to all of you.
While I was still trying to identify the squad that suddenly came to our aid, the blond Feline has already ziplined to the center of the battlefield.
She descended from the sky, and bombastically made her way into the center of the Arts Circle's blood-red pillar of light. The sound of rocks blasted apart ring throughout the entire battlefield.
'Thump.'
\nI can see each and every swing of her large sledgehammer in that red light.
'Forward!'
The Feline's voice ignites the tank's engine.
\nI see a warrior holding a sledgehammer up high leading the Victorians to retake our land.
Look! Look how easily our Victorian tank fire can blast that thing apart!
We said as much long ago. Them bloody devils are no match for Victoria's military!
Crush them!
No, there are too many Originium crystals in town...
The mayor's office, the small town square, the library... those things we've been rebuilding day in and day out...
We won't make it in time—
Is it over?
No...
The pillar of red light rises from the building we built and intermingles with the festive fireworks.
\nThere is a blood-red color boiling in that dark abyss.
\nThe similarly red worms are reaching their antennae toward the sky.
The Arts Circle has been damaged. The Vampires' offspring have gone berserk. Seize this opportunity!
Infantry units, stop advancing. Escort all citizens out of the Arts Circle's range.
Tank squad, follow me and push forward. Destroy the remaining Originium crystals in the town and commence search and rescue!
Hell is invading my town.
\nAll while the formation's rumbling tank accelerates and blitzes in on the devils.
